subject: Follow-up: SOC 2 Type II - additional MFA & access review evidence
messages:
From: Sara Turner <sara.turner@medsynergy.com>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@medsynergy.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 Type II and supplemental control evidence request

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. Our security team is completing vendor due diligence for a planned rollout and asked us to collect a couple of items in addition to your SOC 2 Type II report:

- MFA enforcement evidence (policy + sample auth logs showing 2FA prompts and outcomes) for the period Sept 1 — Nov 30, 2026
- Quarterly access review exports showing reviewer, review date, and remediation actions for Q3 and Q4 2026
- A short bridge letter that confirms your audit period and whether there were any significant control changes since the report date

Can you confirm whether you can provide these items and an approximate delivery date? If any of this needs an NDA or additional intake, let me know.

Best,
Sara Turner
Lead IT Risk Analyst
MediSynergy

Attachment: request-form-2026-11.pdf (pdf)

From: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Turner <sara.turner@medsynergy.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II and supplemental control evidence request

Sara —

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide the SOC 2 Type II report and targeted control artifacts. Quick clarifications so we scope extracts correctly:

1) MFA logs: do you need raw authentication events (user id, timestamp, result, method) or a redacted sample? We can provide a redacted CSV and a small anonymized sample with full fields.
2) Access reviews: do you want the reviewers' comments and proof of remediation (ticket links), or just the exported spreadsheet with reviewer and status?
3) Bridge letter: we can draft a short bridge letter. Do you need this signed on letterhead or is a PDF from our compliance team sufficient?

Planned timeline: SOC 2 report + summary (today) ; redacted MFA sample + access review export (by Thu Dec 3) ; bridge letter draft (by Fri Dec 4). If your team needs a different window, we can prioritize.

Attaching: redwood_soc2_type2_summary.pdf (summary of report, redactions removed) for your intake team.

—Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0127

Attachment: redwood_soc2_type2_summary.pdf (pdf)

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Turner <sara.turner@medsynergy.com>, sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:24:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II and supplemental control evidence request — MFA / logs details

Sara, Sofia —

Looping in technical details from our security team. Short answers and what we can deliver: 

- MFA evidence: we will provide a redacted CSV of authentication events for the requested period (2026-09-01 to 2026-11-30). Columns: user_hash, timestamp_utc, auth_method, outcome (success/fail), challenge_type. We will hash user identifiers and include a map key under NDA if you require re-identification. Sample file: mfa_log_sample_2026Q4.csv (attached).

- Enforcement proof: we will include the MFA configuration snapshot (policy version id, enforcement date) and a screenshot of the admin console showing the enforcement rule.

- Access reviews: export will include account_id_hash, reviewer_email_hash, review_date, status (approved/removed/mitigated), and remediation_ticket_id. We will also include an exported XLSX that links remediation_ticket_id to JIRA/PR numbers where available. Attached: access_review_export_2026Q3-Q4.xlsx.

Redaction & privacy notes: logs are PII-sensitive. We will replace email/usernames with salted hashes and only provide raw identifiers under a separate NDA with a documented key rotation plan. Let us know if MediSynergy requires raw identifiers.

If you need a narrower slice (e.g., only admin accounts or only users with MFA failures), tell us the filter and we can produce that in 48–72 hours.

—Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Security Engineering
Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai

Attachments: mfa_log_sample_2026Q4.csv (csv), access_review_export_2026Q3-Q4.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Sara Turner <sara.turner@medsynergy.com>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 08:41:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II and supplemental control evidence request — MFA / logs details

Thanks Vivek — that format should work. A couple of follow-ups: 

1) We do need raw reviewer emails for access reviews (not hashes) so our audit team can confirm reviewer independence. We can execute an NDA for identifier re‑mapping if you prefer.
2) For MFA logs, please include an admin account slice and a complete failure/error sample.

Bridge letter: our procurement team wants the bridge letter to explicitly state the SOC 2 audit period and confirm no material control changes between the end of the audit period and the issuance date. If possible, include whether any exceptions were noted and their remediation status.

Can you confirm if the NDA is sufficient for re-identification or if you need an executed DPA addendum? Procurement copied here (procurement@medsynergy.com).

Best,
Sara

Attachment: procurement-intake-bridge-specs.docx (docx)

From: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Turner <sara.turner@medsynergy.com>, procurement@medsynergy.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 04 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II and supplemental control evidence request — delivery and next steps

Sara / Procurement team —

Thanks — confirmation below and next steps.

1) NDA & identifier re‑mapping: our legal team is fine with executing a limited-scope NDA that permits re-identification of hashed identifiers solely for your audit review. We will send a short NDA today; once executed, we will provide the raw reviewer emails for the access review export.

2) Deliverables & ETA:
   - redwood_soc2_type2_full_report.pdf (full report, delivered today)
   - mfa_log_sample_2026Q4.csv (redacted sample + failure slice) — delivered Dec 4 (attached)
   - access_review_export_2026Q3-Q4.xlsx (redacted; will provide raw emails post-NDA) — delivered Dec 4 (attached)
   - bridge_letter_draft.pdf — attached draft; we will sign on letterhead after you confirm wording and sign the NDA

3) Bridge letter specifics: we included explicit language about the audit period (audit period ended 2026-09-30), report issuance date (2026-11-15), and a statement that there were no material control changes affecting tested controls between 2026-09-30 and 2026-11-15. Please confirm if procurement requires additional wording (e.g., reference to SOC 2 vendor or auditor).

4) Security ticket: we opened SEC-442 to track the NDA and raw-identifier release. Link: https://jira.redwood.internal/browse/SEC-442.

I am copying Neha to coordinate procurement-level logistics and V ivek for any technical follow-ups. If acceptable, we will route the signed bridge letter through DocuSign and upload the final artifacts to the Drive link shared earlier.

Next steps: Procurement to confirm NDA scope and any DPA addendum. Once NDA signed, we will produce the raw reviewer emails and the minimal re-identification key.

Thanks —
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0127

Attachments: mfa_log_sample_2026Q4.csv, access_review_export_2026Q3-Q4.xlsx, bridge_letter_draft.pdf
